host.description: The hostname or IP address where the application server listens.

port.description: The port on which the application server listens.

issuer.description: Public issuer URL used by Discovery and JWT iss. Defaults to http://<host>:<port>; override OAUTH_ISSUER in production.

redis.description: Redis connection used for sessions and token storage.

alg.description: Signing algorithm (RS256 is required for the management JWT).

admin.description: First-party management client. The server owns and idempotently updates this row on startup.

client-id.description: Fixed BIGINT auth_client id (default 2). Must match VITE_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID.

redirect-uris.description: Exact allowed redirect URIs. Production should use HTTPS.

scopes.description: Management scopes allowed for the client; must include at least one manage:* scope.

grant-types.description: Only authorization_code and refresh_token are allowed for the management client.

cloudflare.description: Turnstile is required by the login and registration handlers.
